Each week: what's coming, what's working now, and what you can safely ignore — in plain language, no hype. For business owners who'd rather move forward than chase every new thing.

item.description:
Most business owners are using AI completely wrong — and it's costing them hours every week. 

Here's the 3-layer architecture that actually works.

📎 Book a free AI discovery call with Chris: chrismichaelharris.com
🤖 Check out SPARC Connect: sparcmarketing.ai

Watch video: https://youtu.be/g34inVip-X4

📺 Subscribe for real AI workflows from someone actively building in 2026

We just wrapped an in-person mastermind here in Austin, and one pattern was everywhere: coaches and service providers deploying AI tools that don't talk to each other, running agents with no guardrails, and wondering why AI isn't delivering the transformation they keep hearing about.

In this episode of The CMH Show, Chris Harris reveals the 3-layer AI architecture he uses to run The Business Lounge — and the framework he unveiled at the mastermind that's helping coaches finally make AI work for their business, not against it. Layer 1 is the thought partner with rich context. 

Layer 2 is the connected ecosystem of tools. Layer 3 is agents that execute ambient tasks — all bidirectionally connected through a central hub.

⏱️ TIMESTAMPS:
0:00 — The biggest AI mistake business owners are making
1:00 — AI as enhancement, not replacement — you at the center always
2:00 — Layer 1: What a real thought partner looks like (vs. a cold thread)
2:30 — Layer 1B: The SPARC framework layer — specialized knowledge baked in
3:30 — Why marathon threads without context are costing you output quality
5:30 — Layer 2: Automations and connections — making your tools talk to each other
6:00 — MCP access explained: the USB-C of the digital world
7:00 — Layer 3: AI agents — what they actually are and how they work
7:30 — The three types of agents: server-side, browser-side, desktop-side
8:00 — Orphan agents: the VA problem you didn't know you had with AI
9:00 — The Sunday night report — bidirectional data flow in practice
11:00 — The body analogy: brain, central nervous system, hands and feet
12:00 — What the full ClickUp-connected architecture looks like practically
14:00 — The lead research agent demo: 30 minutes → 30 seconds
15:30 — SPARC agents and how clients deploy them for their specific needs
16:30 — Generic AI vs. the SPARC ecosystem — Kim's visual explained
17:00 — Free discovery call CTA

item.title: How I Use Claude + Calendly + ClickUp To Automate Discovery Calls
item.itunes:summary: A lead booked a discovery call on a Friday afternoon. Before I sat down, my AI had already researched them, built a ClickUp pipeline card with talking points, and sent a personalized follow-up email — in under 10 minutes. Here's the full workflow. 📎 Book a free AI discovery call with Chris: chrismichaelharris.com 💬 Talk to Tarvis on my website: chrismichaelharris.com → concierge 🤖 Check out SPARC Connect (in BETA): sparcmarketing.ai Watch video: https://youtu.be/qHmB__H241k In this episod...
item.description:
A lead booked a discovery call on a Friday afternoon. Before I sat down, my AI had already researched them, built a ClickUp pipeline card with talking points, and sent a personalized follow-up email — in under 10 minutes. Here's the full workflow.

📎 Book a free AI discovery call with Chris: chrismichaelharris.com
💬 Talk to Tarvis on my website: chrismichaelharris.com → concierge
🤖 Check out SPARC Connect (in BETA): sparcmarketing.ai


Watch video: https://youtu.be/qHmB__H241k

In this episode of The CMH Show, I'll walk you through an AI-powered lead management system built on Claude, Gmail, Calendly, and ClickUp. 

When a new lead books a discovery call, the system automatically researches the prospect via Gmail, surfaces their background, tech stack, and qualification level, builds a fully populated ClickUp sales pipeline card, and drafts a personalized follow-up email using the lead's own language — all triggered from a voice prompt on a phone.

This isn't a theoretical AI use case. It's a live walkthrough of a real workflow that saved over 90 minutes of manual prep — done on the go on a Friday afternoon.

⏱️ TIMESTAMPS:
0:00 — The lead came in on a Friday afternoon (context)
0:30 — Why speed of response is a conversion multiplier
1:00 — The MVP: Calendly link → Gmail notification → Claude research
1:30 — SPARC Concierge: the future version of this lead qualification flow
2:00 — How Claude pulls lead data from Gmail via MCP access
2:30 — The research reveal: "This is your most qualified prospect right now"
3:00 — What the ClickUp pipeline card includes (and how it's built)
3:30 — Talking points, tech stack, team size — all from one voice prompt
4:30 — Drafting the follow-up email — and why I don't pretend AI is me
5:30 — The Tarvis email: using the lead's exact words from their form
6:30 — The integrity principle: transparency as a conversion advantage
7:30 — The future agent-automated version of this workflow
8:00 — Discovery call CTA

item.description:
I recorded a 30-minute podcast and walked away with a blog post, email, 5 social clips, and show notes — without writing a single word. Here's the exact system I used.


📖 Book An AI Strategy Call:
https://calendly.com/chris-chrismichaelharris/30min


OR ☎ 

Text Me 'SPARC' to (866) 498-2080 to learn about how to get EARLY ACCESS to my brand new AI Product, SPARC Marketing!


Watch video: https://youtu.be/e5I1R21-kEI?si=CfDnZ1hApHumx_aS

Most coaches spend hours repurposing content — or skip it entirely because there's no time.

In this episode of The CMH Podcast, I'm doing a live walkthrough of the SPARC Content Engine: the AI-powered content system built by Chris Harris and Kim Jimenez at The Business Lounge that transforms a single transcript into four publication-ready assets, each optimized for its specific channel using proven marketing frameworks.

The difference isn't a smarter AI. It's frameworks baked into the generation.

Watch me take a real transcript through the entire session — from voice calibration to blog post, email, clips list, and show notes — while explaining exactly what each output does that generic AI repurposing can't.

⏱️ TIMESTAMPS:
0:00 — I didn't write a single word (cold open proof)
0:45 — Why generic AI repurposing produces generic output
1:00 — The AI slop risk — and why YouTube is already demonetizing AI accounts
2:00 — What SPARC Connect is and how it works inside Claude
3:30 — How SPARC Content Engine is different from a custom GPT
5:00 — Live demo: activating the Content Engine with a real transcript
6:30 — ICA and Messaging Map integration — the guardrail that makes outputs convert
8:00 — Voice calibration: how it extracts AND cross-references your voice
9:00 — Content analysis through the ACC (Attract / Connect / Convert) lens
10:00 — Why most coaches only do Attract — and what's missing
11:00 — The million views / zero sales problem (and the fix)
12:00 — AEO-optimized blog post: what it includes that generic AI skips
16:00 — The TL;DR capsule, FAQ section, and entity signals explained
18:00 — Content upgrade idea and post-publish promotion checklist
19:00 — Gardener framework email: why it works even if they never click
24:00 — Three subject line options and why one is never enough
26:00 — Clips list: methodology-based selection vs. selection by vibes
33:00 — Platform-specific captions — not the same text reformatted
36:00 — Show notes and AEO YouTube description

item.description: Join us on the CMH Show as we dive into the transformative world of artificial intelligence and its impact on our lives, businesses, and society. In this episode, we break down the AI revolution into distinct eras—from the Adoption and Adaptation Eras we're living through now, to the Expansion, AGI Crisis, Energy Crisis, and the New Paradigm Era on the horizon. Discover practical tips for business owners to leverage AI, prepare for massive economic shifts, and thrive in an era of unprecedented abundance. item.description:
In this episode of the CMH Show, we dive deep into the common struggle of overwhelm that many online business owners face. If you're feeling lost amidst the complexities of running your business, you're not alone. Join Chris as he shares his insights on how to navigate the intricacies of online marketing and find clarity in your strategy.

Chris discusses the evolution of content creation, moving beyond simply producing content to focusing on intentional marketing strategies that drive sales. He emphasizes the importance of differentiating yourself in a crowded market and showcases how to leverage your unique abilities to stand out.

Listeners will learn about the Content to Customers Method, which includes:

 

  • The Capture Phase: How to effectively engage your audience.

 

  • The Monetization Phase: Turning engagement into sales.

 

  • The Advertising Phase: Strategies for scaling your efforts.

 

 

Chris also introduces the Problem Solution Content Map, a valuable resource designed to help you identify your audience's pain points and provide actionable solutions that lead them to your offerings.

Whether you're a seasoned entrepreneur or just starting out, this episode is packed with practical advice and strategies to help you overcome overwhelm and create a meaningful impact in your business.

Tune in now to discover how to unlock clarity and take actionable steps toward your goals!

A mere minutes into the game, McSherry called time, turned to the umpire's dugout, took a few steps and collapsed in a heap on the field....

item.itunes:title: EP3: Ditch the Pitch | The Curse of the Idea Guy
item.title: EP3: Ditch the Pitch | The Curse of the Idea Guy
item.itunes:summary: In this episode, Chris outlines what embodies the "Idea Guy" in entrepreneurship and how to become a more refined entrepreneur. Although there is nothing wrong with being a person that has no shortage of ideas, there are some potentially dangerous traits and patterns that these folks display that can hinder their ability to put their ideas into motion and make them real. Chris is admittedly an "Idea Guy" and he discusses ways in which he has learned to embrace that and utilize it to ...
item.description:
In this episode, Chris outlines what embodies the "Idea Guy" in entrepreneurship and how to become a more refined entrepreneur.  

Although there is nothing wrong with being a person that has no shortage of ideas, there are some potentially dangerous traits and patterns that these folks display that can hinder their ability to put their ideas into motion and make them real.

Chris is admittedly an "Idea Guy" and he discusses ways in which he has learned to embrace that and utilize it to his advantage.
item.content:encoded:
In this episode, Chris outlines what embodies the "Idea Guy" in entrepreneurship and how to become a more refined entrepreneur.  

Although there is nothing wrong with being a person that has no shortage of ideas, there are some potentially dangerous traits and patterns that these folks display that can hinder their ability to put their ideas into motion and make them real.

Chris is admittedly an "Idea Guy" and he discusses ways in which he has learned to embrace that and utilize it to his advantage.
item.itunes:author: Chris Michael Harris

item.itunes:summary: In this episode, Randy Williams will provide us with his life story of immigrating to the United States from British Guiana and eventually becoming the most decorated officer in the history of the FAA. Randy now works as a private consultant with clients to defend civil rights and liberties. Having been faced with some difficult situations in life, Randy had more than enough reason to lose sight of his passion and purpose but has been steadfast in his pursuit of helping ot...
item.description:
In this episode, Randy Williams will provide us with his life story of immigrating to the United States from British Guiana and eventually becoming the most decorated officer in the history of the FAA.  Randy now works as a private consultant with clients to defend civil rights and liberties.   

Having been faced with some difficult situations in life, Randy had more than enough reason to lose sight of his passion and purpose but has been steadfast in his pursuit of helping others realize their potential and achieve their dreams.

Randy is Chris' personal Life Coach and Mentor, having known one another for over 20 years.
